_comment: DNSLytics (api.dnslytics.net v1) endpoint path templates + per-call credit cost + budget for wp_dnslytics.py. apikey travels as a query-string param, not a header. accountinfo is FREE (0 credits) and used only to prime the balance cache; reverseadsense/reverseganalytics/reverseip are pay-as-you-go premium calls billed against the account's prepaid credit balance. Overrides the inline _DNSLYTICS_FALLBACK; a missing/bad file degrades to that fallback with a warning.

endpoints._comment: v1 REST paths joined to https://api.dnslytics.net/v1; {q} is the URL-encoded query value (id or IP).

credits._comment: per-call prepaid credit cost, charged against the account balance read from accountinfo.

budget._comment: per-run guard rails: call ceiling and the min balance to keep before degrading to a note.
